cases.name: groups_neighbors
cases.sql: SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY n GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS fv,LAST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY n GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS lv FROM qualification_frames ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: Three peer groups [10],[20,20],[30]; first of prior-through-current and last of current-through-next group.

cases.name: frame_exclusions
cases.sql: SELECT id,LAST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) AS without_current,FIRST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) AS without_group,FIRST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) AS without_ties FROM qualification_frames ORDER BY id
cases.derivation: For current exclusion remove only current ordinal; for group remove equal ORDER BY peers; ties retain current but remove other equal peers. Endpoints of remaining ordered rows give literal values.

support: Finite INTEGER peer fixture only; no added frame grammar or native promotion.
